title: Privacy Policy - Hero
text: Privacy Policy. Last updated: January 2026. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.

title: 1. Information We Collect
text: We collect personal information that you provide directly to us when you interact with our school, including: Contact details: name, email address, phone number, postal address. Child information: name, date of birth, medical information, dietary requirements, emergency contacts. Academic records: assessments, reports, attendance records. Payment information: billing details, transaction history (processed securely via our payment partners). Communication records: emails, WhatsApp messages, enquiry forms, meeting notes.

title: 2. How We Use Your Information
text: We use your personal information for the following purposes: To provide educational services and care for your child. To communicate with you about your child's progress, school events, and administrative matters. To process fees and manage financial records. To comply with legal obligations (Ghana Education Service, NaCCA, data protection laws). To improve our services and website experience. To ensure the health, safety, and welfare of all children in our care.

title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
text: Under Ghana's Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) and international standards, we process your data on the following lawful bases: Contractual necessity: to fulfil our agreement to educate and care for your child. Legal obligation: to meet regulatory requirements from GES, NaCCA, and other authorities. Legitimate interest: to operate our school effectively, communicate with parents, and improve services. Consent: for marketing communications (newsletter, event invitations) where you have opted in. Vital interests: to protect the health and safety of children in emergencies.

title: 4. Data Sharing and Disclosure
text: We do not sell your personal information. We share data only in these circumstances: With your explicit consent. With authorised staff who need it to perform their duties (teachers, administrators, support staff). With regulatory bodies (Ghana Education Service, NaCCA, social services) where legally required. With payment processors for secure fee transactions. With IT service providers who host and maintain our systems (under strict data processing agreements). In response to a valid legal request, court order, or to protect vital interests.

title: 5. Data Retention
text: We retain personal information only as long as necessary for the purposes outlined above, and in compliance with Ghanaian education and tax record-keeping requirements. Typical retention periods: Enrolment and academic records: 7 years after the child leaves the school. Financial records: 7 years for tax and audit purposes. Medical and health information: until the child reaches age 21, or 7 years after leaving, whichever is longer. Communication records: 3 years after last contact. Website analytics data: 26 months (anonymised).

title: 6. Your Rights
text: You have the following rights regarding your personal data: Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you or your child. Rectification: Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data. Erasure: Request deletion of data where there is no compelling reason for us to continue processing it. Restriction: Ask us to restrict processing in certain circumstances. Portability: Receive your data in a structured, commonly used format. Object: Object to processing based on legitimate interests, including direct marketing. Withdraw consent: Withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at info@novastarmontissorischool.com or call +233 24 493 5251.

title: 7. Data Security
text: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, destruction, or alteration. These include: Secure, encrypted connections (HTTPS) for all website interactions. Role-based access controls for staff systems. Regular security assessments and staff training. Secure disposal of physical records. Data processing agreements with all third-party processors.

title: 8. Cookies and Website Analytics
text: Our website uses essential cookies for functionality and optional analytics cookies (with your consent) to understand how visitors use our site. You can manage cookie preferences via the cookie banner or your browser settings. We use privacy-respecting analytics that do not track individuals across sites.

title: 9. Children's Data
text: We take extra care with children's personal data. We only collect what is necessary for their education and welfare, and we never use children's data for marketing or profiling. Parents and guardians exercise data protection rights on behalf of their children.

title: 10. International Transfers
text: We do not routinely transfer personal data outside Ghana. If a transfer is necessary (e.g., cloud hosting), we ensure adequate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or the recipient's participation in a recognised adequacy framework.

title: 11. Changes to This Policy
text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be posted on this page with the "Last updated" date. Material changes will be communicated directly to parents via email or the parent portal.

title: 12. Contact Us
text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact our Data Protection Officer: Novastar Montessori School. Email: info@novastarmontissorischool.com. Phone: +233 24 493 5251. Address: Ayeduase New Site, K-5 Junction, Ayeduase Road, Kumasi, Ashanti Region, Ghana.

title: Questions About Your Data
text: Questions about your data? We're happy to explain how we handle your information or help you exercise your rights. Email Us. Contact Page.
